description: Second iteration: tighter car/moto following to cut discharge headway and queue (M1, M5, M6), stronger red running and early start for motorcycles (M2, M3), fewer space seekers with lower right-lane probability (M9, M10a), longer box release lag (M7a).

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car headway was 0.84-0.96 s vs 0.39 s observed in all four it01 specs, and queues (M5/length 47-58 m vs 13 m) and M6 approach times followed; lower tau, minGap and sigma plus higher accel shorten the discharge headway and queue. Impatience stays low for M3/share/car and M2/early/car.
Small tight-following car group pushes M1/car headway further toward 0.39 s and shortens M5/length; impatience 0.3 without jmDriveAfterRedTime keeps M3/share/car near 0.003.

M1/moto headway 0.52-0.63 s vs 0.30 s observed: minimum tau 0.4, minGap 0.5, accel 6 and sigma 0.2 shorten it and cut M5/length and M5/moto_density; filtering params target M4 overshoot; jmDriveAfterRedTime 3 s lets some ride on after red for M3/share/moto.

Aggressive riders target M3/share/moto (0.09 vs sim 0.01-0.02) and M3/per_cycle (4.4 vs 0.4-1.0) through impatience 0.8 and a 5 s drive-after-red time, and M4/overshoot_share via larger lateral speed and sublane freedom.

Smaller slow share (was 0.10-0.15) with speedFactor 0.85: M6 approach times were already 2-5x too long, so slow riders must not add congestion; they only keep the slow-rider mechanism for M6/approach moto and M4/lat_moto.

Space-seeking custom1 riders for M10a (sidewalk 0.27/cycle) and M9a (right-lane straight vehicles 0.33/cycle); share 0.15 (it01: 0.10-0.25 gave M9a 0.87-4.6 and M9b/share_blocked 0.15-0.30 vs 0.02) with a smaller right-lane probability.

Same parameters as it01_s03, the best box result (M7b/clear_lag 6.0 vs 6.65 s, M7a/release_time 0.36 vs 2.6 s); jmTimegapMinor 1.0 kept; release_time is raised by the rule's release lag instead of by gap parameters (jmTimegapMinor 0.6-0.8 gave negative release times).

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto 0.13 vs sim 0.004-0.007: executed creeps were mostly 'red_ended_before_crossing' (57 of 89), so use the full 10 s window and v_max 5 m/s so the creeper crosses before green, with p 0.5 over the front row; cars excluded (M2/early/car 0.001).

M3/share/moto 0.09 and M3/per_cycle 4.4 were 4-10 times too low (0.01-0.02, 0.4-1.0 veh/cycle) with p0 0.04-0.15 on fewer riders; p0 0.3 on all non-slow motorcycles with k 0.1 raises the count and keeps M3/var_to_mean (it01 1.2-1.7 vs 1.31) clustered.

M9a was 0.87-4.6 vs 0.33 veh/cycle with p_right_lane 0.03-0.1, so cut it to 0.01 and halve the seeker share; M10a: p_sidewalk 0.06 gave 0.21 vs 0.27 in it01_s00 (0.02 gave 0.03-0.09), so use 0.07; wrong lane was inapplicable (sim 0, R27) so it is set to 0.
M7a/release_time 0.36 s (it01_s03) vs 2.6 s observed, M7b/clear_lag 6.0 vs 6.65 s: a longer extra hold of 1.8 s (was 1.0) moves both up toward the targets.
Slow riders stay in lane centre for M6/approach moto and M4/lat_moto; kept unchanged with a smaller share.
